def M1(p):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,w=p[:7]
    return P*(a+b*t+c*np.sin(w*t)+d*np.cos(w*t)) - e*P*np.log(P)+f*P**2
def M2(p):
    r0,r1,r2,k0,k1,k2,w=p[:7]
    r=r0+r1*np.sin(w*t)+r2*t
    q=k0+k1*np.sin(w*t)+k2*np.cos(w*t)
    return r*P - P**2*q
def M3(p):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,w,k=p[:10]
    s=np.sin(w*t); co=np.cos(w*t)
    return a*P-b*P*np.log(P)+(c+d*s+e*co)*P**2+(f*s+g*co)*P + k*t
def M4(p):
    a,b,c,w,K,dd=p[:6]
    r=a+b*t+c*np.sin(w*t)
    return r*P*(1-P/K) + dd*P*np.log(P)
